behavior: A Foundry workspace in packages/contracts builds and tests, and a chain config plus RPC picker returns a working RPC per testnet: each Infura key in turn, then public RPCs
acceptance: forge build and forge test pass in packages/contracts with OpenZeppelin 5.x pinned, and CI runs them on pull requests; the package is a pnpm workspace package run by Turborepo, and PLAN.md/AGENTS.md place contracts in packages/contracts and the Go backend in apps/backend

packages/contracts/chains.json lists Base Sepolia 84532, Arbitrum Sepolia 421614, Arc testnet 5042002, Tempo Moderato 42431 with Infura network names where Infura serves them and public RPCs; node packages/contracts/script/rpc.mjs <chain> prints the first URL whose eth_chainId matches, trying every key in INFURA_API_KEYS before public RPCs
.env is git-ignored, .env.example lists INFURA_API_KEYS, DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY and REFUND_AUTHORITY_PRIVATE_KEY without values
docs/spikes/s5-s6-testnets.md records per testnet: chain id, RPC results, CreateX, CREATE2 deployer and Safe factory presence, test token contracts and decimals, with sources and date

proof.1: contracts check (forge build/test) passed; CI installs Foundry and submodules
proof.2: rpc.mjs run per chain: Infura for Base/Arbitrum/Arc, public for Tempo; skips keys without access
